batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c R Ashwin b BW Hilfenhaus

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b BW Hilfenhaus

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c MEK Hussey b JA Morkel

batting.name: Y Venugopal Rao
batting.dismissal: c JA Morkel b R Ashwin

batting.name: MEK Hussey
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b IK Pathan

balls.text: tries to scoop it over fine-leg, another slower one and beats the batsman, they do not run the bye because the batsman was in a rather difficult position, especially to run.
outside the off stump, goes for a heave, it was a slower one and that did not help his timing, spooned up but in the gap behind the fielder at mid-wicket
swung away but goes to mid-wicket for a single
slower one, outside the off stump, was lining up to smack it away, gets an outside edge as he mistimed it, and goes through to Dhoni on the bounce, needed to dive to stop it.
pitched right up to the batsman, has no place to drive but straight down the ground to long-off
outside the off stump, full-toss, goes outside the off and flicks it to deep square-leg
that is a crazy shot for six, again, moved around a little, pushes a yorker outside the off stump, he gets some bat to it, a bit of a bottom edge, one hand off and it carries over covers for a six!
moves around in the crease, sends a fullish ball, misses it outside the off stump
full-toss and finally a four! It has been a long time coming, one of the few loose deliveries from Ben, and he has been smacked over extra-cover
swings his bat hard yet again and the outside edge takes it to the third-man on a couple of bounces for a single
outside the off stump, left alone by Pathan and that is a wide
gets the yorker in now, the batsman fails to get it anywhere, tapped away to the off for a single
gives himself room, by moving to the leg side, misses hitting it
appeal for a caught-behind, it had an edge alright but went to ground before going to the keeper.
yorker length, jagging back into the bat, reverse swing probably, he manages to get his bat down in time, played away to the leg side for a single
pitched right up to the batsman, dug out well, driven to long-on for a single
pitched up to the bat, driven to extra-cover and it looks like it was mistimed, couple of runs to the left of sweeper
outside the off stump, swinging away, it was pitched fuller but rather wide and the umpire has no hesitation calling it that.
aims for the yorker, misses it, the batsman gets a full-toss, which is flicked away to mid-wicket, where the fielder had come just prior to that ball
shorter from Bravo after he saw Nagar giving himself room, the batsman tried to upper flick it, missed
slower yet again, Pathan was lining up to smack him, but no timing at all, defended back to the bowler
outside the leg stump, tries to pull it away, fails to make contact
goes down the track, Morkel sees it early and is able to shorten the length, pulled to square-leg for a single
full length ball, pitched right up to the bat, outside the off stump, misses getting it through
slower one yet again, outside the leg stump, wanted to pull it away gently, almost tap it to the leg side, mistimed
slower ball, on the leg stump, tries to nudge it away to square-leg but can only defend it back
tries to pull it away, gets bit of an inside edge to the leg side
shorter from Ashwin, played away to the short fine-leg, single and the end of an excellent spell from Ashwin
shorter ball, tries to cut it but goes to Morkel at short cover
goes down the pitch and drills it through the covers for a couple of runs
carrom ball probably, tries to hoick it over, mistimed the shot, looped high up and Raina went back to take it, good effort to get to it and then drops it!
shorter from the bowler, tries to cut it away, mistimed it
slower from Ashwin yet again, outside the off stump, paddled to fine-leg for a single
on the off stump, played away to mid-on for a single
outside the off stump, widish, wanted to hit it over extra-cover and missed by the left hander
on the off stump, played away to the leg side, they get a single and by the time Srikkanth throws it back to the keeper, Pathan comes back for the second
quicker, on the stumps, and defended back to the bowler
short ball, comes on slightly quicker than he thought it would, pulls to square-leg for a single
bouncer by Bravo to start his second over, ducks under it
pitched up, goes down the track and drives it to long-on for a single
quicker this time outside the off stump, tapped to the off side
middle stump line again, he is getting some turn, played away to the leg side for a single
on his pads, turning away from the left hander, plays it back to the bowler
tries to hit him inside out, and he is caught! He was trying to chip it over cover, there was a short cover in place, Morkel dived to his left and takes a very good catch!
outside the off stump, slower, gets a leading edge to the off side and they get a single
outside the off stump, defended on the off side and that ends a good over for Delhi
shorter again and cut away to the sweeper fielder for a single, he is rather quick on his feet
short from the bowler, turning away but cut away to the extra-cover fielder for them to come back for the second
and he comes down again, the length is shortened and he is able to change his shot and drive it to long-off
goes down the track this time and has been spanked over long-on for a six! He was trying this to Ashwin as well but this one he connects
pitched right up to the bat, opens the face of the bat, guided to the off side for a single
shorter this time, allows more time to play it to the leg side and they get a single
tries to work it to the leg side, leading edge, almost carries to the bowler
goes down the track and smacks him, it went high in the air and for a moment it looked it was going away, but that is a long part of the ground
flighted up by Ashwin, the ball holds up and defended to the off side
on the off stump, turning into the bat, played away to the square-leg region for a single
outside the off stump, guided away to the off side for a single
quick feet movement, cuts it well from the stumps as well, but goes to the fielder
outside the off stump, goes down the track and drives it to the sweeper, where they get a single
too close to play the cut, pitched up and he tries it, misses, goes to the keeper
pitched right up to the batsman, driven to long-off for a single
on his pads, down the leg side and driven to mid-wicket for a single
shorter, spins away from the batsman, the shortness of the delivery allows him to flick it away to the leg side
outside the off stump and he late-guides it to the off side, single taken
flights it up, defended on the front foot
floated up and outside the off stump, goes down the track and drives to mid-on
pitched right up to the bat, driven to the leg side
shorter one from Ashwin, turning into the bat, tapped to the off side for a single
flighted outside the off stump, a little turn, inside edge to the leg side for a single
pitched up on the off stump, carves it to the off side for a run
on his pad again, short of a good length again and that has been flicked away for a single
flighted again, on-driven where the mid-wicket fielder comes in and it is only a single
angling into the batsman, driven the over pitched ball to long-off
outside the off stump, tapped it away to the off side
goes down the track and lofts him over the long-on region for a six!
on the off stump, tapped away to the off side for a single, five of them this over
on the middle stump and worked it away to the leg side for a single
defended on the off side and they go for a quick single, Bravo tries another direct hit at the non-striker's end, misses
the line is more towards the leg side for this one, the batsman came a long way across, hit on the pads, down the leg side
pitched up on the off stump, driven to mid-off
middle stump, pitched up, gets a leading edge through to the off side for a single

missed! Run-out chance missed, it had fallen next to the batsman and he wanted a single, Bravo ran to the on-side and picked it up, threw it back to the stumps, the batsman was way out of his crease and given up.
outside the off stump, shorter and moving away, goes for a cut and misses, wide called

pitched up to the bat, on the stumps flicked to midwicket, they wanted the single, then suddenly both stopped before going through and Hussey threw it the striker's end, could have been close had it hit
jagging back into the batsman from outside the off stump, does well to defend it to the off side and take a quick single
on the middle, pulled the length up and it is nurdled away to fine-leg for a single
bouncer this time, following the slower one, ducks under it and lets it go through to the keeper
slower one, pitched right up to the bat, defended back to the bowler
on the middle stump, 134.8 km/hr, played away to the square-leg for a single
on his pads, on a length, wanted to flick it away through square-leg but the drift takes it away and hits the pads
length ball, outside the off stump, moving slightly away, beats his outside edge
short of length, bounce and guided away to the third-man fielder for a single

pitched right up to the bat and that is flicked to mid-on! That is almost a soft dismissal, it was fuller and should have been dispatched to the fence, instead it loops up for the mid-on fielder to hold on to a simple catch.
short of length, on the middle stump, flicked away to short fine-leg and wanted a single, sent back

on his pads, it seems to have flicked something on its way to the keeper, there is an appeal from the bowler, but the keeper did not go up. Flicked the gloves, the umpires are looking for whether it carried, actually he had caught it way above the ground but he struggled to hold on to it, almost popped out, but does well to cling on it in the end, that is three down!
slower one, 107.2 km/hr, defended on the front foot and Ojha called MJ through for a single
outside the off stump, pushed to the off side for a single
short ball, it did not rise up as much as it would have usually, but it was good enough to hit him on his gloves and lob up, but no-one nearby!
on the middle stump, fuller and driven to mid-on, was a slightly slower ball, 131.6 km/hr, he has been bowling in the 140s
outside the off, pitched on a good length and Ojha brings his foot out and defended to the off side
short of good length, quicker and down the leg side, almost surprises the batsman with the pace, but a wide called
this was pitched outside the off stump, up to the bat as well, tempting him to drive it through the covers, but goes to the fielder, dives and manages to field before they can think of a single
on the off stump, not too quick, pushed to the off side for a single
on his pads again, pitched up, flicked away well but the field was set for that delivery, the deep square-leg was back and fielded well
short of length yet again, this time slower, opens the face of the bat and gets it through to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, short of length ball, the feet went nowhere and it's missed, through to the keeper
on the off stump, pushed to the off side but to the fielder
pitched up to the bat, pushed back to the bowler, no swing that time
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it through the point region for a couple of runs, timed well
half volley on his pads and that has been flicked away to square-leg for a four!
short of length, tapped to the leg side, fielded by square-leg
outside the off stump, pitched right up, swinging away, driven to the covers
pitched up, outside the off stump and an invite to go over the top, mistimes it and it is drilled straight to the mid-off fielder, end of the centurion now!
on the off stump, length ball, defended on the front foot
pitched right up to the bat, driven over extra-cover, in the air and they are able to come back for the third.
outside the off stump, punched to the covers, no chance of a run
outside the off stump, length ball, defended out to the off side and a loud call of a no.
outside the off stump and that is driven through the covers for a four, continues from where he left off last game!
swings in as well, pitched up, from off stump to the middle and defended cautiously back to the bowler
On his pads but some swing yet again, hits him on the pads and falls to the leg side, end of a good first over

bowled him! Late movement there again, pitched fuller, on the middle and moves away from the captain, misses it and uproots the stumps, that was an excellent follow-up delivery after a poor start to Sehwag!
on his pads and that has been flicked away to the fine-leg for a four, this was drifting far too down the leg side and Sehwag needed to only get some bat there
another one swinging in, but this time from the middle stump, inside-edge to square-leg for a single
movement into the bat, and hits the pads, huge appeal against Warner but Doctrove thinks it could have been high.
outside the off stump, moving into the batsman, defended to the covers, a confident-looking push that was

outside the off stump, tries to hoick it over the leg side, gets a top edge, goes high in the air and two fielders were converging for it, no-one got to it and they get a couple. Oh but wait, there is an overthrow and they come back for the third and that is game, set and match Chennai!
round the wicket, angling in, pitched right up and driven back to the bowler
pitched up and driven but straight to the covers, no run taken
short ball, tries to crack it over third-man, gets under it and it went straight to the third-man fielder, Rao, who catches it and then floors it immediately!
outside the off stump yet again, drilled through the backward point region and they are able to come back for the second
gives himself room, opens the face of the bat, gets an inside edge to square-leg for a single
change of pace, outside the off stump, tapped to mid-off for a single
gives himself room and that has been smacked over the covers for a six!
short ball from Aaron, allows it to go through to the wicket-keeper
outside the off stump, pitched up and he has only punched it over extra-cover for a six!
round the stumps, opens the face of the bat and dabs it away to third-man for a single
yorker length ball, tapped away to the off side, fielded by the bowler on his follow-through
short ball, wanted to pull it away, hits his body and rolls over to the leg side for a single
on the off stump, played away to the off side and to the fielder
short ball, tries to play it over third-man, misses it
short of good length, pushed to the off side, single to the covers
outside the off stump, 145.8 km/hr, opens the face of the bat, guided to the third-man
poor ball, down the leg side, 142.5 km/hr, Raina gently guides it away to fine-leg for a four
yorker yet again, on the middle stump, tapped back to the bowler
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, wanted to guide it through third-man, misses, through to the wicket-keeper
turn and bounce and going away, misses the outside edge of the bat, keeper collects
short ball, pulled away by Raina, to deep square-leg for a single
full-toss, down the leg side, wanted to flick it over the fine-leg, this seemed to have hit the batsman on his body and it is called a wide, hit him flush. Change of call later...
short of length, driven through the covers for a single
outside the off stump and tapped gently to the point region, they are away for a single
outside the off stump, played away to the off side for a single
and this is another short ball, pulled away, top edge that goes away for a six! For most part of that stroke, it looked like it could have been caught, but it sails over fine-leg
short once again, went for the pull and misses, clearly rattled by the previous stroke
short ball from Pathan, gets early into the stroke, plays it before it came on, hits the grill of the helmet after spanking his forearm
outside the off stump, tries to drive on the up, gets an inside edge and it goes to fine-leg for a single
on the off stump, punched to mid-on and they are off for a single
gone this time, cut away from outside the off stump, but straight to the fielder at point and Hussey's aggressive innings has been nipped short
jumps out of the track again and that has been played up and over the extra cover fielder for a couple of runs
played away to the fine-leg fielder, they are able to come back for a second
Dropped? quicker, tries to cut it away, there seemed to be an edge and the wicket-keeper has grassed it
pitched up on the middle, goes down the track and drives it to short cover
on the pads, spinning slightly, pushed to the leg side
round the stumps, bowled outside the off stump, driven to long-on for a single
pitched up to the bat, slower ball, defended back to the bowler
outside the off stump, length ball and Vijay has slammed it over mid-wicket for a four, in form this is his favourite shot
on his pads, dabbed to the leg side for a single, it went straight to mid-wicket but it was hit too hard
slower this time, outside the off stump, pushed through the covers and that gives them a single
on his pads, flicked away to the leg side for a single
change of pace from Pathan, short of length, pushed back to the bowler

round the stumps, angling into the bat, played away to the leg side and they take a single before turning back for the second. It was tapped gently to push the deep fielder, but hard enough for the wicket-keeper to take time to get to it.
flicked away for a single to the leg side
short of length, goes back to the back foot, played away to short fine-leg
another one attempted from Hussey, but was a lot quicker and misses the shot
first ball to Hussey and that has been reverse swept through third-man for a four, the fielder was up in the circle and that is rather well played
pitched up to the batsman, outside the off stump, driven to the covers
length ball outside the off stump, punched to the sweeper fielder for a single, doing it easily here
outside the off stump, length ball, driven to the covers
down the leg side, flicked away for a four, the square-leg was up in the circle and he is able to flick it away very easily
this was shorter from Yadav and that has been spanked away over point, and also beats the third-man with ease
full-pitcher yet again, pushed to the off side and to the fielder
pitched on the middle stump, fuller from Yadav, flicked to the leg side for a quickly taken single
outside the off stump, tapped away to the off side
another yorker length ball, this time Hussey is rooted to his crease, digs it out, goes to the leg side and they take a single
was going down the track, slowed it down to 118.2 km/hr, through the shot, missed and it misses the stumps too
yorker length ball, angling into the batsman, driven to the off side, no run to the point fielder
pitched right up to the bat, full-toss, driven to mid-off and Hussey stops in his track
goes down the track, it was pitched up and he slashes it away over point, carries over the third-man boundary for a six!
length ball on the middle stump, pushed back to mid-off
pitched up to the bat and he has flicked away to square-leg for another four, third of the over!
Ooh, missed, that was on his pads, played away to backward square-leg, Vijay wasn't sure of the run but went anyway, van der Merwe fielded well and throws it to the stumps, the batsman had given up
short of a good length, goes on to the back foot, defends it to the off side
outside edge and that has gone for a four. There was a slip in place and it beats both, the slip and the third-man, 15 off the last four balls
on his pads and that has been flicked over square-leg for a four, Morkel's strayed in his line

hoicks it over mid-on not timed well, goes high in the air, Yadav runs back and jumps and prevents it from going into the fence, they still take three and that means that the run-rate has ticked over six.
round the wicket, outside the off stump, goes down the track and slashes it over point for a four!
on the middle stump, inside edge to mid-on and a bit of confusion between the two for the single, finally they go for it
short of length, quick ball, 138.7 km/hr, he jumped while playing that stroke, loops up on the leg side
outside the off stump, pitched on a length, defended to the off side
flicked away to the leg side for a couple of runs, was a length ball and played away well
pitched up this time, on the middle stump, driven back to the bowler and that ends another over where they get no wickets, do the Daredevils. Need some early ones.
outside the off stump, Hussey was trying to drive it through, gets a thick edge that goes up over backward point and rolls over for a four
outside the off stump, pitched right up and driven to mid-off, still no run
short of length, wanted to go for the drive on the up, and misses the outside the edge, surprising choice of shot from Hussey
good length ball, on the middle, flicked away to the fine-leg for a single
down the leg side, flicked his pads through to the diving wicket-keeper, well-taken and there was an appeal too but did not hit the bat
good length ball, defended on the off side and that ends a decent over for the Super Kings
tapped away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, swinging away from the batsman, driven to point, goes through to third-man for a couple
140.3 km/hr, length ball, tries to drive it through covers, mistimed it to the covers
outside the off stump, wanted to smack it through point, moved away from the bat, beats the outside edge and it is called a wide
outside the off stump, there was some width, pitched up too, driven through to the covers, the fielder got some hand to it, but still goes for four
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, swinging away from the batsman, gets it on the toe, to the covers
pitched up to the bat, driven but straight to mid-off, probably wanted to get Hussey driving and nicking at it
short of length, beautifully bowled, missed the outside edge, swinging away from the bat
on the middle stump, defended back to the bowler
on the leg stump, flicked away to fine-leg and they get a single...and then Hussey turns back and quickly comes back for the second
outside the off stump, very outside in fact, there was a loud appeal from the wicket-keeper, who is miked up, it sounded even louder!
outside the off stump, short of length, left all alone
